beats.en: Can an elephant and a stray dog be best friends? They are so different in size, in food and in the way they live. Yet this story from the Jataka tradition says real friendship does not depend on being alike.

textbookBox.concept: Friends are important because we play, share and feel happy with them. The book asks you to complete sentences like: with my friend I play, with my friend I feel happy.

beats.en: Gajaraj is an elephant who lives in the best booth of the royal stables. The king is fond of him and orders that he be well looked after. Despite all the royal comforts, Gajaraj is sad because he has no friends.
beats.speakEn: Gajaraj is an elephant who lives in the best booth of the royal stables. The king is fond of him and orders that he be well looked after. Despite all the royal comforts, Gajaraj is sad because he has no friends.

textbookBox.concept: One evening a stray dog wanders into the stable, tired and hungry. Gajaraj pushes some of his own food towards the dog. The dog wags his tail to say thanks, eats and falls asleep.

beats.en: One evening a stray dog wanders into the stable, tired and hungry. Gajaraj pushes some of his own food towards the dog. The dog wags his tail to say thanks, eats and falls asleep.
beats.speakEn: One evening a stray dog wanders into the stable, tired and hungry. Gajaraj pushes some of his own food towards the dog. The dog wags his tail to say thanks, eats and falls asleep.

beats.en: A farmer passing by sees the dog and shouts Buntee. The dog runs to him and the farmer hugs him, because he had been searching for his lost dog. The mahout has no objection to the farmer taking the dog home.
beats.speakEn: A farmer passing by sees the dog and shouts Buntee. The dog runs to him and the farmer hugs him, because he had been searching for his lost dog. The mahout has no objection to the farmer taking the dog home.
